title: Jeddah Tower
geometryBasis: The exact nine-point OpenStreetMap outline locates the three wing tips, inner corners and central core. The architect confirms the continuous three-wing taper.
sectionBasis: Kingdom Holding reports a 482 m structural construction milestone at level 120. The local CC0 photograph confirms exposed deck edges, sections of lower glazing and roof construction equipment from the preceding milestone.
limitations: This is the 2 November 2026 construction snapshot. The cleared exterior photograph dates to May 2026 at about 100 floors. Upper wing deck positions, formwork, cranes and the progression of the glass toward November are estimated.

The finished tower, neighboring construction and underground works sit outside the model scope. Floor spacing varies in the real building. The host terrain is the original Terrarium surface and local concrete foundation depth is an estimate.
